description: Replay a game .rec recording through versioned deterministic kernels and compute its chain head. With expectedHead this is an integrity check with three outcomes: "reproduced" (some registered kernel reproduces the head — authentic), "not-reproduced" (no registered kernel does — tampered, or from an unregistered game version), "premise-broken" (facts digest matches no kernel). Without expectedHead it proves the recording is replayable and reports its head plus the kernel version used. Old recordings verify against old kernels — kernel upgrades never falsify them.

expectedHead.description: Optional: the claimed 64-hex chain head to check against

kernelVersion.description: Optional: verify with one specific registered kernel version (e.g. "0.1"); default tries all

name: game_verify_rec
